items.title: A ring map with a section has an exact extended cochain complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that if the ring map R to A admits a section, then for every R-module M the extended cochain complex is exact (statement lines 740-745). The proof is a homotopy argument: a cited simplicial lemma turns the map from the constant cosimplicial ring R to the cosimplicial ring associated to A over R into a homotopy equivalence of cosimplicial algebras (proof lines 748-752); tensoring with M preserves the homotopy, because tensoring is a functor from algebras to modules and homotopies are preserved by functors (proof lines 753-758); the induced map of associated complexes is therefore a homotopy equivalence (proof lines 759-761); and the complex associated to the constant cosimplicial module is displayed explicitly with alternating identity and zero maps, which is visibly exact, so the original complex is exact as well, the extension by one more copy of M at the front adding nothing (proof lines 762-770). The claim is H2: the argument is a chain of three transfers of a homotopy equivalence, each with its own justification, ending in an explicit display of the contracting complex, and it is the author's own; nothing is left to the reader.
